main_text.p: Stola, Pallium: & synecdochicè Involucrum, vestimentum, in quod mortui involvuntur. Plural. תַּכְרִיכִין.
כַּרְכּוּמָא Chal. Aes, chalybs, Græc: χαλκὸς, χάλκωμα, quod affine, R & L inter se permutatis.
כַּרְכְּמִישָׁא Ch. Plumbum, Num. 31.22. in Jon.
כַּרְכּוּשְׁתָּא Chald. Mustela, Levit. 11. 29. in Jon. Veneta mendosè habent כַּרְכּוּשְׁתָּא.
כַּרְמָא Chal. & Syr. Vinea. Plur. כַּרְמִין, כַּרְמַיָּא, Cum Aff. קַטְפּוּיִת בַּרְמֵיהוֹן Vindemiarunt vineas suas, Judic. 9. 27.
כְּרוֹם־יַמָּא Ch. Nomen lapidis pretiosi, Beryllus Thalassius, sive marinus, Exo. 28.20.
כּוּרְמִיזָא Ch. Fustis, Exod. 21. 18. Jesa. 58. 4. Resp. Hebr. אֻגְרָף Pugnus.
כַּרְן Chal. Idem quod Hebraicè עַצְם Ille, ipse, Hic-ipse, ipsemet, עַר כַּרְן יוֹמָא הָדִין Usque ad hunc ipsum diem.
כַּרְסָא Ch. כַּרְסָן Syr. Venter, Uterus. Plur. emp. Vētres ociosi, ad Tit. 1. 12.

כּוּרְסְיָא, כּוּרְסִי, כַּרְסִי Ch. & Syr. Thronus, solium, cathedra, כּוּרְסִי דְמַלְכוּתָא Soliū regale, Gen. 47. 40. Plur. כָּרְסִין, כּוּרְסָוָתָא, Syr. ܟܪܣܘܬܐ, Matth. 19. 28. emphat. ܟܪܣܘܬܐ Mar. 11. 15. Videtur esse deductum ab Hebraeo כִּסֵּא, inserto ר.
כְּרוֹסְפְּרָא Ch. Ora, Fimbria. Plur. כְּרוֹסְפְּרִין, Num. 15. 38. Græc. κράσπεδον.

page.notes: The Hebrew, Syriac and Greek forms are copied as far as legible; several Syriac and Hebrew words in the scan are blurred and given approximately. Bottom line is a Syriac word, possibly a catchword or entry continuation.
